result.description: A fictional ultra-wide desktop monitor built for immersive creative work and gaming. It features a 34-inch QD-OLED panel with 3440x1440 resolution, 175Hz refresh rate, 0.03ms response time, HDR support, USB-C with 90W power delivery, and a fully adjustable stand. The display uses an anti-glare coating and a subtle ambient light ring for low-light setups.
